status.draftBody: Only you can see it. Publish it when you want the rest of the family to find it.
status.publishedBody: Everyone with an account can read it. Photos, albums and slideshows still follow their own library access.

empty.heading: No stories yet
empty.body: A story weaves photos, albums, slideshows, maps and your own writing into one page — the trip, the wedding, the year you moved.

fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.subtitlePlaceholder: Three weeks, two tents, one very tired dog
fields.introPlaceholder: A few opening lines for the story's front page
fields.chapterNounHint: Chapters then read “Day 1”, “Day 2”. Leave empty to use their titles.
fields.coverHint: The front page and the story's card wear it. Without one, the first photo in the story stands in.

collections.heading: Collections
collections.descriptionPlaceholder: Our family, one story at a time
collections.accessIntro: People listed here see this collection and its stories — everywhere, including search and tags. Contributors can also add stories to it; managers can edit every story and this list. Admins always have full access.
collections.everyoneHint: All members — the baseline. “No access” restricts the collection to the people listed below.
collections.deleteBody: The collection is deleted. Its stories are not — they become standalone and stay exactly where every member can find them.
collections.emptyBody: Add a story and it will take its place on the timeline by its own dates.
collections.pickerHint: The shelf this story sits on. Its access then decides who sees the story.

confirm.removeBlockBody: It comes out of the story. The photo, album or slideshow itself is not affected.
confirm.removeChapterBody_one: The chapter and the {{count}} piece in it come out of the story. The photos, albums and slideshows themselves are not affected.
confirm.removeChapterBody_other: The chapter and the {{count}} pieces in it come out of the story. The photos, albums and slideshows themselves are not affected.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Tags connect this story with the photos, people and other stories that share them.

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.intro: A guest link opens this story in a browser, with no account. It stays up to date — whoever opens it sees the story as it is now.
share.expandAlbumsHint: Off, a guest sees only the photos this story shows. On, they can open every photo in the albums and slideshows it embeds.
share.copyNow: Copy it now — this link is shown only once.
share.noLinks: No guest links for this story yet.

audio.intro: Record someone telling this part of the story, or upload a recording you already have.
audio.micRefused: The microphone is not available. Check the browser permission, or upload a file instead.
audio.noRecorder: Recording needs a secure connection (https). You can still upload a file.
